main_measure.name: t of the mean daily timing gain (position x (next-day return - coin mean daily return)), summed per day across coins
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: Welch t of next-day excess return, deepest third minus shallowest third by depth (pass: difference < 0 and t <= -1)

decided_by: Mean daily timing gain positive with t >= 2 and the deepest-minus-shallowest Welch t <= -1.
reading: Up day = close above the prior close in the same window (first bar: recorded regime); position = postRebalance_current_allocation; days with no case are left out of the daily series; terciles are pooled over all coins on the raw depth (last_history_value, most negative = deepest); the minimum is read as at least 300 cases and at least 100 distinct days, either failing gives not observable.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.005093 on the check folds against +0.009517 on every fold
